Veterans Benefits: Texas has no state individual income tax, so military retirement pay is untaxed. Disabled veterans receive a residence-homestead property-tax exemption scaled by VA disability rating, with a full exemption for 100% or totally disabled veterans and surviving-spouse provisions.

Description: Del Rio sits on the Texas-Mexico border across from Ciudad Acuna, built around Laughlin Air Force Base (47th Flying Training Wing, the Air Force's largest pilot-training wing). It pairs a low crime rate and an in-city VA outpatient clinic with Texas's no-income-tax treatment of military retirement pay and affordable homes (typical value about $210,000). Tradeoffs include a hot semi-arid climate, a remote location (~150 mi from San Antonio), and no local Costco.
